note: Written from the reference photos (Street View, Aug 2008, taken outside number 25). Only descriptions live here, never pictures.

defaults.comment: The street's general look: 1980s/90s Scottish suburb on a slope. Harled (roughcast) walls, white to beige, with red-brown brick bases; concrete tile roofs in dark grey or red-brown, mostly hipped; brown timber/uPVC windows; front lawns, block-paved or gravel drives, timber fences; tall grey lamp posts; a dark conifer wood on the hill behind.
defaults.backdrop: dense dark conifer woodland on the rising ground behind the houses
